Uncava public site.
Brand lifted from the app: Geist for UI, the isometric-cube mark (bare glyph, currentColor), the UNCAVA wordmark in Montserrat 200 (uppercase, .38em), the UNCAVA palette, and inferred purple for AI output only.
Company and executive names, and every report figure, are fictional samples. Anything in [brackets] needs a real fact from you.
